name: Koga Rindou Suzuka
original_name: 久雅 竜胆 鈴鹿
source:
The current head of Koga House, which is the main of the six generals' houses: Koga, Nakanoin, Rokujou, Iwakura, and Chigusa. These houses are in charge of the country's military affairs. As its head, Suzuka carries the honorary title of Eboshi. However, her title is mostly nominal, since she is a woman with strange ideas who is treated as an exotic beast. The most influential person among the houses of generals may be considered [url=https://vndb.org/c34807]Nakanoin Reizen[/url], who loves her and proposes a marriage, yet she rejects his advances. She is also known as the Demonical Princess Koga, as she is as relentless as a man. In the past, her father asked his friend [url=https://vndb.org/c34804]Mikado Ryuumei[/url] to become a guardian for her, and so [url=https://vndb.org/c34804]Ryuumei[/url] and Suzuka's relationships are close to those of a daughter and parent. It is thanks to [url=https://vndb.org/c34804]Ryuumei[/url] that she got a splendid education and knowledge of the art of war.

Together with the heads of all five houses of generals, she attended a Fencing Kagura ceremony. Her house, unlike others, did not prepare an honorable warrior for the ceremony. It has been agreed that the leader of the impending Eastern Expedition will also be her spouse. [spoiler]But as the ceremony continued, Shuzuka began to see it as a "dance of dead ones" and interjected. After that, [url=https://vndb.org/c34796]Sakagami Habaki[/url] appeared, became her vassal, defeated all other honorable warriors and granted her the position of commander.[/spoiler]

Shuzuka is a charismatic, strong-willed, and inspiring figure who may be considered a type of commander who leads an army oneself and inspirits every warrior. [spoiler]Being a foreign body in the World of Tengu, she despises its egocentrical ways and infects people with her ideal: one should care and respect not only oneself, but also others and cherish their bonds. Her contribution to the Eastern Expedition has played a big part in its success.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]In truth, she is a Self Destructive Factor of [url=https://vndb.org/c34796]Sakagami Habaki[/url]. She cannot die unless he dies. Suzuka was leading him, whom she liked, to his death. Due to it, she was recognized by the Longinuslanze Testament, the testament of [url=https://vndb.org/c22061]Reinhard Heydrich[/url], as a new master and used it as arrows. But she became more enchanted with him over time, and her desire to be with [url=https://vndb.org/c34796]Habaki[/url] eventually outweighed her hidden desire to kill him. It has led to fruitless efforts to end ties with her vassal.

[i]In the end, Suzuka discarded her role as a Self Destructive Factor and chose to be with [url=https://vndb.org/c34796]Habaki[/url]. With this, the true Hehemony was born.[/i][/spoiler]
